body:
Adds `research/radar-clutter-twin` (Digital twins theme): a CA-CFAR detector whose threshold is set in a Gaussian-clutter radar twin and deployed in gamma-textured clutter.

- Exact false-alarm law, matched to direct Monte Carlo (~1%)
- Inflation 9–30× at design 1e-4; threshold repair cost 1.9–3.7 dB
- Shared texture across the window leaves CFAR unaffected
- Real-cell calibration budget (moment fit of ν)
- 8 tests; README, whitepaper, homepage entry (`python site/build.py` prints ok)

Stylised: no target, no measured data.
